title: Chapter 209
content:
Chapter 209

Donghuang Taiyi didn't even think about it, breaking the boundary and ascending is just like ascending through the tribulation in those cultivation worlds.

With him being a big boss in the dark in a small low-level world, where does he have the luck and talent to achieve things that many gods and Buddhas in the middle-thousand world can't do!

Not everyone is as lucky as himself, who has obtained the legacy of his previous life and can travel through the heavens and worlds at will.

For other people who are not as lucky as Zhong Yu, if they want to break through the world barrier and go to other worlds, they must either break through with extreme strength, or find the treasure that can travel through the heavens, there is no other way.

However, these two conditions are so difficult. The Eastern Emperor does not have absolute strength, so he will always be trapped in this world and cannot escape.

And another condition, which kind of treasure, can this small world of Qinshi Mingyue possess? Almost all of them are in the hands of the sons of luck in the big world, or the great powers of heaven and earth, so how could they fall into the hands of the Eastern Emperor Taiyi, who is not even dust compared to the heavens and worlds.

"Really? It turns out that I am just an ant!" Hearing the words of King Jing in front of him, Donghuangtai laughed at himself for a while. For the first time, he felt that the talent and strength he was proud of in the past were so small and insignificant. humble.

"Your Excellency, Donghuang, don't be too frustrated. Your strength is already quite outstanding compared to this level of the world. Why should you compare with those heaven's favored sons of the heavens and worlds? The fundamental difference between the two lies in the level , It’s like the difference between ants and human beings is incomparable!” Seeing that Donghuang seemed to be hit by himself, which was not in line with his purpose, Zhong Yu comforted him a little.

"Your Highness doesn't need to be like this. I can get to where I am today, so I won't be defeated by mere words. Your Highness has told me so much, what do you need me to do? What do you need the Yin Yang family to do?" Dong Huang waved his hand , indicating that he has no problem, and then asked what the person in front of him meant.

"Although I come from outside the region, the heavens and myriad worlds are so vast. If you want to reach the peak, you can't do it alone in many places. Therefore, you need many heroes to come to help you. Your Yin-Yang family is very strong. If you can Help me, on the way to the peak, it will definitely be much faster!" Zhong Yu invited Donghuang Taiyi with a sincere face.

The Yin Yang family, the entire school is located among the hundreds of schools, it can be said to be at the top, and all of them are masters, not ordinary mortals, with strong strength, with their joining, Yuguo's strength will definitely be stronger.

As for the fact that if the Yin-Yang family harbors evil intentions and temporarily hides under Yu Guo's wings, and then rebel when the time is right, Zhong Yu is not very worried.

Don't forget that the exercises he practiced are good at deceiving people's hearts. As long as people from the Yin Yang family stay in his world and live in his world for a period of time, they will definitely be affected, and a trace of loyalty will be born in their hearts. After a long time, slowly , which became their real thoughts.

"The Yinyang family is willing to serve the imperial country!" Donghuang Taiyi bent his waist that he had never bent before, and said his oath of allegiance to the person in front of him.

"Haha, okay, with the help of your Yin Yang family, the empire's unification of the world will definitely accelerate!" Zhong Yu praised with a few laughs.

"Your Highness is serious. Your Highness is a person outside the sky. His status is extraordinary. Serving His Highness is also in accordance with the time of the day. It is an irreversible trend!" Shaking his head, the Eastern Emperor Taiyi complimented.

"Since the Yinyang family has surrendered to Yuguo, then they are members of our empire, so don't be so alienated!" Zhong Yu was a little surprised to see Donghuang Taiyi's cautious look.

In fact, this is not too surprising. The Eastern Emperor Taiyi was originally just a native of this world, and what he heard and saw was limited to such a small world. Hearing the vastness of the outside world all of a sudden, even if he climbed to the top of this world, held a high position, and faced the visitors from outside the sky, he still felt a little in awe in his heart.

"Although the Yinyang family has surrendered to the empire, don't expose it for the time being. You continue to take shelter under the Qin State and rely on Qin State's strength to develop. At the critical moment, you are showing your identities. You should understand what I mean?" Yin Yang Now that the surrender of the family was a foregone conclusion, Zhong Yu began his real plan.

"Yes, the minister must pay attention to what His Highness said!" Dong Huangtai nodded and said in response.

"Since that's the case, you can go, don't forget your current identity!" With a slight chin, Zhong Yu told Donghuang Taiyi to leave.

...

After Donghuang Taiyi, several groups of people came to visit, most of them were some unknown ordinary forces, but they had a relatively strong prestige in a certain county.

It can be considered that some large-scale forces that are insufficient compared to the top and have more than the bottom, although they are not as good as the hundreds of schools of thought, but compared to ordinary places, they are much more powerful, and their support makes Zhong Yu's attention.

Among them, the only one who can make Zhong Yu pay more attention is the famous Gongsun Linglong, a supporting role who appeared many times in the original work.

But don't look at his unbearable performance in the original work, but in fact she is thoughtful and eloquent. The reason why she is so funny in the original work is just because she met Zhang Liang, a more enchanting person.

More importantly, as the ancestor of a once glorious school, Gongsun Linglong's strength is still extremely outstanding, with first-class mid-term strength, which is still much higher than the previous five elders of the Yin Yang family, and he can be regarded as his famous family. The identity of the leader.

It can be said that the famous people's refuge is aboveboard, and it is known to the world very quickly. This incident has aroused many people's thinking.

Although Yu Guo came from the barbarian land in the north, he is extremely outstanding in terms of military strength and the vastness of the country, surpassing all other countries in the world.

Moreover, looking at the situation of many people in the country, and the news sent by spies from all over the world, in various aspects, they do not look like barbarians.

On the contrary, there is an endless stream of talented people in Yuguo, all of whom are full of self-cultivation and rich knowledge. Even a low-level official or a local chief official in a small county town has rich personal cultivation. Much stronger.

This kind of situation has attracted all the caring people in the world, and they can't help but feel secretly jealous.

If Yuguo is just a military empire with strong military force and the domestic cultural background is very weak, then it can still make the countries feel relieved.

But he not only has force, but also culture. Just in line with the old saying, hooligans are not to be feared, only the hooligans are educated.
